title: Vineplicate
description: A mod based on the original version that indirectly replicates items using vines.
body:
## Description | 描述

A mod based on the original version that indirectly uses vines (including Vines, Weeping Vines, and Twisting Vines) to replicate items.
Created by MCreator, please be aware of the incompatibility of the MCreator code.

一个基于原版，间接利用藤蔓（包括藤蔓、垂泪藤、缠怨藤）复制物品的模组。
使用 MCreator 制作，请注意 MCreator 代码存在的不兼容性。

Additionally, the author's English is generally average, so in order to be lazy, all the content is machine translated. We apologize for any inconvenience caused. orz

另外：作者英语其实一般，所以为了偷懒所有内容都是机翻的，非常抱歉。orz

## Content | 内容

The module mainly consists of three machines:

模组主要包含三台机器：
![Modular Machine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/750d219c92e75fefbae9d34a40a6eedda43f59ce.png)

Fig1 Modular Machine
图1 模组机器

Incubator (left in Figure 1), Aggregator (middle in Figure 1), Aotoaggregator (right in Figure 1)
生蔓机（图1左）、聚蔓机（图1中）、自动聚蔓机（图1右）

### Incubator | 生蔓机
![GUI diagram of the vine growing machine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/add6a6a4dadb25cd2d68f83d367680e3fb4a3427.png)

Fig 2 GUI diagram of the Incubator
图2 生蔓机GUI示意图

The Incubator is the main method for producing vines in this module.
- Figure 2 ①: Input slot 1, where vines (Vine/Weeping Vine/Twisting Vines) can be placed. When there are any vines in this slot, the vine production speed of slot ③ will be doubled, and (if slot is not occupied) the output of slot ③ will be changed to be the same as its own.
- Figure 2 ②: Input slot 2 can hold bone powder, which will be consumed and provide a production speed doubling of approximately 320 seconds.
- Figure 2 ③: Output slot 3, producing vines as the progress bar is full. The types of vines produced first depend on the existing vine types in slot 2, then on the vine types in slot 2, and finally on the following rules:

生蔓机是本模组生产藤蔓的主要方式。
- 图2①：输入槽1，可以放入藤蔓（藤蔓/垂泪藤/缠怨藤）。当此槽位存在任意藤蔓时，使③槽位的藤蔓生产速度翻倍，且（若槽位没有占用）会将③的输出变更为与自身相同。
- 图2②：输入槽2，可以放入骨粉，骨粉放入后会消耗，并且提供约320秒的生产速度翻倍。
- 图2③：输出槽3，随进度条满产出藤蔓，产出的种类首先取决于槽位中已有的藤蔓种类，其次取决于②槽位的藤蔓种类，最后取决于以下规则：

![What items can change production rules](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c656e1744f35fc5be346bcd09762adde3042ff21.png)

[The content to be translated. The general meaning is which items can change production rules.]

- 若生蔓机上方方块为诡异菌柄、去皮诡异菌柄、诡异菌核、去皮诡异菌核、诡异菌岩、诡异菌索、诡异菌索盆栽、诡异菌、诡异菌盆栽时，产物为缠怨藤（图3 上）。
- 若生蔓机上方方块为绯红菌柄、去皮绯红菌柄、绯红菌核、去皮绯红菌核、绯红菌岩、绯红菌索、绯红菌索盆栽、绯红菌、绯红菌盆栽时，产物为垂泪藤（图3 下）。

### Aggregator & Auto Aggregator | 聚蔓机与自动聚蔓机

![Schematic diagram of the Aggregator GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99f11817c5150ab558f1583e87fd698ca5dc585d.png)
![Schematic diagram of the AutoAggregator GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eab6cc557438eb9a228ca076dd4be028157aabaa.png)

Fig 4 Schematic diagram of the Aggregator GUI & Fig 5 Schematic diagram of the AutoAggregator GUI
图4 聚蔓机GUI示意图 & 图5 自动生蔓机GUI示意图

- Figure 4 ①: Input slot 1, allowing vines to be placed. By default, a progress is generated every 8 vines, and the progress will be displayed on the progress indicator bar on the right.
- Figure 4 ②: Input slot 2. When the generation progress is full, the Juman crystal will be generated here, or it can be manually inserted. Juman Crystal will be consumed during replication.
- Figure 4 ③: Input slot 3 and place the item to be copied.
- Figure 4 ④: Output slot, where copied items will appear.
- Figure 5 Confirm button: When the confirm button is pressed, the machine will first perform a copy and then attempt to generate Juman crystals. By default, items with a stacking limit of 1 cannot be copied.
Automation button: When pressed, it will switch whether it is automated or not, and when turned on, it will display the word "AUTO". After activation, the automatic vine growing machine will automatically consume vines or attempt to copy items.
  
- 图4①：输入槽1，允许放入藤蔓，默认情况下每8个藤蔓提供一点生成进度，进度将于右侧进度指示条显示。
- 图4②：输入槽2，生成进度满时，聚蔓水晶将生成在此处，也可以手动放入。聚蔓水晶将会在复制中被消耗。
- 图4③：输入槽3，放入待复制的物品。
- 图4④：输出槽，复制的物品将会出现在此处。
- 图5确认按钮：按下确认按钮时，机器将会先执行一次复制，然后再尝试生成聚蔓水晶。默认情况下，堆叠上限为1的物品不能被复制。
自动化按钮：按下时将切换是否自动化，开启时将显示“AUTO”字样。开启后，自动生蔓机将会自动消耗藤蔓或者尝试复制物品。

## Command | 命令
- /gamerule checkitemstack false/true Change Yes/No to allow copying of items with a stacking limit of 1 (default is false).
- /gamerule conversionrate number Changes to 'how many vines can increase progress by 1 point' (default is 1).
- /gamerule usevinetexture true/false Change the texture of the progress indicator bar on the right side of the vine growing machine and automatic vine growing machine (default to true).

- /gamerule checkitemstack false/true 改变是/否允许堆叠上限为1的物品复制（默认为false）。
- /gamerule conversionrate 数字 改变“每多少藤蔓可以提升 1 点进度”（默认为1）。
- /gamerule usevinetexture true/false 改变生蔓机以及自动生蔓机右侧进度指示条的纹理（默认为true）。
